title: U-Con 2018 Set 2: Bandit Fort, Beggar, King's Court, Pooka

sources.author: Adam Horton
sources.note: Michigan U-Con 2018 Tournament Summary; Set 2018-2, Horton finished 2nd

quality_note: Horton lost this 3P game (2nd) and says the board was designed to have nothing good; his own plan is uncertain.

kingdom.setup_notes: Tournament rule (U-Con): players may arrange their starting decks, so they choose a 4/3 or 5/2 opening. 3-player game. Druid's set-aside Boons: The Moon's Gift, The Sea's Gift, The Wind's Gift. Pooka's Heirloom: each player starts with Cursed Gold in place of one Copper.

edition: First-edition Scout, Noble Brigand and Embassy.
